description: Fetches one AI music analysis by id (GET /ai-music/jobs/{id}): state (uploading, queued, running, cancelling, done, failed, cancelled), progress, queue position and, once done, the report in "result" (score 0 to 100, verdict signals-detected / few-signals / inconclusive, per-detector windows, and for the v3 report the classification human / processed-ai / pure-ai). The report is an aggregated index of signals, not a probability and not proof of origin: present it as such. A job of another account answers 404. Needs the queue:read scope. Costs no quota.

id.description: Job id returned by jj_ai_music_analyze (a UUID).

name: jj_ai_music_get_job
title: Get an AI music analysis and its report
